reviews.name: Manish Yadav
reviews.review: The best part about As Multiverse courses are their mentors, they actually help to the extreme. I am glad I took this course and enjoyed learning throughout. The instant 1:1 help I got is what i liked the most and will recommend everyone to go for it.

Thanks!
